methodology.notes: System under test: Ona, OnArrival's agent harness, through a τ²-bench v1.0.1 agent adapter (custom scaffold): a pi-agent-core model loop (parallel tool steps, retries with backoff) on gpt-6.1-sol (OpenAI, served through Microsoft Azure) at reasoning effort high, with Ona's core instructions plus τ²'s domain policy verbatim as its system prompt. No extra tools, no router, no second model, no gate: the arm submitted is Ona 'as is'. τ²'s tasks, tools, policies, user simulator (gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, temperature 0, the 1.x default) and evaluator are unchanged; all tasks of all three domains, 4 trials each, seed 300. Disclosure: the retail and telecom train-split items outside τ² v2.0.0's frozen subsets (46 and 47 tasks) were used only to choose this arm's reasoning effort (high over xhigh) and to develop a separate policy-checking mode that is not this arm; the agent model was not trained or fine-tuned on τ²-bench data. Cost is not reported per trajectory in USD.

verification.details: The agent's system prompt is Ona's core instructions with τ²'s domain policy verbatim (custom scaffold). The user simulator's prompts, the tasks and the evaluator are unchanged; no task was omitted.
